# Get Programming with Go — Xarici istinadlar

## Kitabın rəsmi resursları
- Go Playground — https://play.golang.org (hər listing/experiment üçün)
- Go sənədləri — https://golang.org/pkg
- Kitab forumu — https://forums.manning.com/forums/get-programming-with-go
- Nümunə kodlar — https://github.com/nathany/get-programming-with-go

## Kitabda keçilən paketlər/alətlər
- fmt — https://pkg.go.dev/fmt
- math / math/rand — https://pkg.go.dev/math
- math/big — https://pkg.go.dev/math/big
- time — https://pkg.go.dev/time
- strings — https://pkg.go.dev/strings
- strconv — https://pkg.go.dev/strconv
- unicode/utf8 — https://pkg.go.dev/unicode/utf8
- sort — https://pkg.go.dev/sort
- errors — https://pkg.go.dev/errors
- os / io/ioutil — https://pkg.go.dev/os
- encoding/json — https://pkg.go.dev/encoding/json
- image (image.Point) — https://pkg.go.dev/image
- sync (Mutex) — https://pkg.go.dev/sync

## Əlavə oxuma (kitabda tövsiyə olunan)
- Go Proverbs — https://go-proverbs.github.io (Rob Pike)
- "Errors are values" — https://blog.golang.org/errors-are-values (Rob Pike, 2015)
- "Null References: The Billion Dollar Mistake" — Tony Hoare (mng.bz/dNzX)
- "understand nil" — Francesc Campoy, GopherCon 2016 (www.youtube.com/watch?v=ynoY2xz-F8s)
- Race Detector — https://golang.org/doc/articles/race_detector.html
- Go users — https://golang.org/wiki/GoUsers
- GoobyExample — https://gobyexample.com
- Go FAQ: methods on values or pointers — https://golang.org/doc/faq#methods_on_values_or_pointers
- Spherical Law of Cosines — https://www.movable-type.co.uk/scripts/latlong.html
- Mars rover architecture — https://mng.bz/Z7Xa
- MAAS API — https://github.com/ingenology/mars_weather_api
